guard: the per-seat Jcode connector log is owner-only and symlink-safe, and only the exact Harness invalid_request capability refusal receives the unsupported-capability classification

mutations.name: Jcode connector logs follow a pre-planted directory symlink
mutations.find: if (stats.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error(`refusing symlinked Jcode connector log directory: ${logs}`);
mutations.expectRed: connector diagnostic log refuses a pre-planted logs symlink
mutations.cell: connector diagnostic log refuses a pre-planted logs symlink

mutations.name: Jcode capability classification accepts copied untrusted Error text
mutations.expectRed: a plain Error with copied capability text stays a generic refusal
mutations.cell: a plain Error with copied capability text stays a generic refusal

mutations.name: Jcode capability classification ignores the stable invalid_request code
mutations.expectRed: a different Harness code with copied capability text stays a generic refusal
mutations.cell: a different Harness code with copied capability text stays a generic refusal

mutations.name: Jcode capability classification accepts any unsupported-reasoning invalid_request
mutations.find: /^invalid_request: Reasoning effort is not supported by the current model\/profile\./.test(error.message)
mutations.expectRed: a near-miss invalid_request message stays a generic refusal
mutations.cell: a near-miss invalid_request message stays a generic refusal
